prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: a production-ready bitmap background for a Chinese historical narrative game's inference interface, CSS background-size: cover.
Input image 1 is the sole edit target. Edit this exact supplied image, preserving its backdrop.
Primary request: completely remove EVERY interface element: all Chinese and other text, every text label and brush backing strip, every node, every connector line, all buttons and icons including the red marker, the large open search/selection panel and its border, top corner headings and controls, and all bottom corner navigation. Seamlessly reconstruct the original backdrop underneath every removed element.
Invariants: preserve the supplied image's airy deep warm-gray silk-like ground, soft matte ink-painting atmosphere and subdued distant mountain silhouettes; retain the existing faint night military encampment, tents, slender flags and landscape mainly along the lower edge, with atmospheric layers fading upward. Preserve the overall composition and quiet central negative space. Keep its warm gray/charcoal balance, without making it browner, denser or more ornate.
Texture: very subtle and diffuse silk/ink texture, smooth atmospheric tonal transitions, low contrast. The upper and middle approximately two thirds must remain calm, spacious and empty so real interface text can later be drawn over it.
Avoid: any text or typography, symbols, UI, dots, lines, arrows, brush labels, rectangular patches or panel shadows, visible remnants of removed UI, bright lights, fire, bright tents, golden glow, saturated brown, heavy paper grain, decorative patterns, new prominent objects, watermark or border.
Output only the clean full-bleed opaque background. Landscape 16:9, target 2048 by 1152 pixels (or 1920 by 1080).
notes: Original source and original generated output preserved. Both saved PNG copies are byte-identical. No code or existing .meta files modified.
